chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there any equivalent to Him.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes Surah Al-Ikhlas as a foundational proof for the Ismaili and Twelver Shia understanding of divine unity, often linking its recitation to the purity of the Imams' hearts. This chapter highlights how the concise declaration of Tawhid serves not only as theological doctrine but also as a spiritual practice reinforcing the infallibility and unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia tradition.
